worked.problem: A closed right square pyramid has base side 8 cm and perpendicular height 3 cm. Find the slant height, volume and total surface area.
actions: Mark square base side 8 cm and perpendicular height 3 cm.
From the centre to midpoint of a base side is 4 cm; l²=3²+4²=25, hence l=5 cm.
Volume = 1/3×64×3=64 cm³.
Four triangular faces total 4(1/2×8×5)=80 cm²; add the base 64 cm² to get 144 cm².
Answer: slant height 5 cm; volume 64 cm³; total surface area 144 cm². Use the slant height for triangle area, perpendicular height for volume.
worked.answer: slant height 5 cm; volume 64 cm³; total surface area 144 cm²
worked.check: Answer: slant height 5 cm; volume 64 cm³; total surface area 144 cm². Use the slant height for triangle area, perpendicular height for volume.
